blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.
blocks.zh: 从水下立体图像中恢复可编辑的计算机辅助设计模型需要准确而完整的几何学,而立体重建则会产生被转移点和缺失区域. 原始观点保留了交叉观点分歧和在点云聚变过程中丢失的射线证据. Aqua2CAD利用了这种证据分为两个阶段:取景条件的校正和质量过滤建立可靠的几何支持,而多视图观测则在推断出原始的度量框中缺失的地表之前将一个已学习到的形状作为条件. 回收的点支持表面装配和固体组装,并手动修改面团. 在基于OceanSim的合成基准上,Aqua2CAD相对于立体重建将点-云相差60%. 与匹配的点状完成主干相比,它提高了缺失区域的恢复率,从16.27%提高到24.16%. 由于共用CAD后端,外接接受率从6/19提高到14/19. 部分真实水下捕捉的定性结果显示了6个3D打印物体的主要结构的恢复.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Underwater inspection and maintenance frequently require accurate measurements of existing components for replacement, adaptation, and fabrication, for example in subsea spool installation and retrofitting [ 1 , 2 ] .
Such tasks benefit from computer-aided design (CAD) models with editable surfaces, explicit boundaries, and connectivity [ 3 ] .
Calibrated stereo cameras, which are commonly available on underwater platforms, provide metric geometry under sufficient visibility [ 4 , 5 ] and are therefore a natural source for recovering such models.
blocks.zh:
水下检查和维修经常需要准确测量现有部件的更换、改造和制造,例如在海底池的安装和改装[1、2]。
这些任务得益于计算机辅助设计模型,其表面可编辑,界限明确,连接性[3].
校准的立体照相机,在水下平台上常见,在足够可见度[4,5]下提供度量几何,因此是回收这种模型的自然来源.

blocks.en:
Recovering such models underwater, however, is considerably harder than on land.
Wavelength-dependent attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and changing illumination severely degrade underwater images [ 6 , 7 ] and, together with weak texture, impair stereo matching [ 5 ] .
Since a practical route to CAD first reconstructs a point cloud and then fits surfaces [ 8 , 3 ] , the resulting errors take two forms: displaced points bias the fitted surface parameters, whereas sparse or missing regions leave surface extents and intersections poorly constrained.
Addressing these challenges requires solving two problems with different operations: correcting displaced points, which cannot recover an absent surface, and recovering missing regions, whose generated points introduce shape hypotheses that must be constrained by the available evidence.
blocks.zh:
然而,在水下回收这些模型比在陆地上要困难得多。
受波长影响的衰减、散射、扰动和不断变化的照明严重降解水下图像[6、7],加上纹理薄弱,损害立体匹配[5]。
由于通往CAD的一条实用路线首先重建一个点云,然后适合表面[8,3],因此由此产生的错误有两种形式:流离失所点偏差了适合的表面参数,而稀疏或缺失的区域则使表面的面积和交叉处受限差。
应对这些挑战需要通过不同行动解决两个问题:纠正流离失所点(无法恢复缺水面)和恢复缺失地区(其产生的缺水点提出了必须受到现有证据制约的形状假设)。

blocks.en:
Our key observation is that a region missing from the fused point cloud is not necessarily unobserved.
Matching, filtering, and fusion may discard geometry for which individual views still contain useful cues, and the original views retain appearance, depth disagreement, and viewing directions that the fused point set does not fully represent.
Point cloud denoising and completion methods that operate on coordinates alone [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] cannot revisit this evidence, whereas image-guided completion exploits complementary image information [ 12 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们的主要观察是,一个从熔点云中消失的区域不一定无人注意。
匹配,过滤,和聚变可能会丢弃个人观点仍然包含有用提示的几何,原始观点保留了外观,深度分歧,以及引信点集并不完全代表的查看方向.
仅在坐标[9、10、11]上运行的点云调试和完成方法不能重温这一证据,而以图像为指南的完成则利用补充图像信息[12、13]。

blocks.en:
This observation assigns two distinct roles to the original observations.
For existing samples, disagreement across views exposes biased points, which can be corrected locally and filtered when they remain unreliable.
For missing regions, the views indicate where a surface is supported and where space is free, so they can constrain a learned shape prior wherever they remain informative, while the prior supplies hypotheses only for the truly unobserved portions.
We therefore decouple the correction of reconstructed samples from missing-shape inference and provide both stages with the original multi-view evidence: the first improves the reliability of the observed support, and the second extends its coverage by observation-conditioned generation.
blocks.zh:
这一意见赋予了原始观察的两个不同的作用.
对于现有的样本,不同观点的分歧暴露出有偏见的点,这些点在当地可以纠正,在仍然不可靠时可以过滤.
对于缺失区域,这些观点表明地面支持在哪里,空间是自由的,因此,只要信息仍然丰富,它们就能够先约束一个已学到的形状,而先前的假设则只针对真正不被观察的部分。
因此,我们对从缺失-形状推论中校正重建的样本进行解析,并为两个阶段提供原始的多视图证据:第一个阶段提高观测支持的可靠性,第二个阶段通过观测有条件的生成扩大其覆盖范围.

blocks.en:
We instantiate this design in Aqua2CAD (Fig. ).
An observation-guided local regressor aggregates view-associated image and geometric evidence and predicts bounded displacements in a geometric vector basis, and a separate quality classifier filters the corrected points.
A multi-view assisted completion model combines the shape features of the filtered points with global image tokens, spatial ray evidence, and local projected features to generate additional points in the metric frame of the reconstruction.
The resulting geometry supports analytic surface fitting and finite-solid assembly.
Since the CAD stage partitions points into face groups with ParSeNet [ 14 ] followed by manual revision, we treat CAD recovery as a human-assisted downstream test of the recovered geometry and do not claim fully automatic image-to-CAD reconstruction.

由于CAD阶段的分区用ParSeNet[14]后手动修改将CAD恢复作为恢复的几何学的人类辅助下游测试,并不声称完全自动的图像到CAD重建.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A view-associated correction mechanism that retains per-view evidence after stereo fusion and uses it for bounded geometric updates and quality filtering. • A multi-view assisted completion model that conditions a learned shape prior on global image context, spatial ray evidence, and local projected features to extend the corrected points into missing regions. • An evaluation on an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark and on real underwater captures, covering geometric accuracy and coverage, component analyses, and the downstream CAD models recovered with a shared fitting backend and human-revised face grouping.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Aqua2CAD lies at the intersection of three lines of work. Underwater 3D reconstruction provides metric geometry and the original observations, point cloud refinement corrects and completes geometry, and CAD reconstruction turns geometry into editable models.
blocks.zh: Aqua2CAD位于三行工作的交汇处. 水下3D重建提供测量几何和原始观测,点云精细校正并完成几何,CAD重建将几何转化为可编辑模型.

blocks.en:
Underwater methods improve stereo through synthetic training and self-supervised adaptation [ 5 ] or model the water medium in neural scene representations [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
Multi-view stereo fuses per-view depth maps after visibility and consistency checks that keep or discard samples with fixed rules [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] , and Point-MVSNet [ 22 ] refines depth with multi-view point features.
These methods target dense surfaces or novel views, and the per-view evidence used during fusion is no longer available once the point cloud is formed.
We retain this evidence after fusion and reuse it to correct points and to infer missing geometry.
blocks.zh:
水下方法通过合成训练和自我监督的适应[5]或模拟神经场景表现中的水介质[15,16,17]来改进立体.
多景立体引信每景深度图经过能见度和一致性检查后,保留或丢弃标本有固定规则[18,19,20,21],Point-MVSNet[22]精炼具有多景点特征的深度.
这些方法针对密集的表面或新颖的视图,一旦点云形成,聚变过程中使用的per-view证据就不再可用.
我们在聚变后保留了这些证据,并重新使用这些证据,以纠正各点并推断缺失的几何特征。

blocks.en:
Learned denoisers move noisy samples toward the underlying surface using a learned score [ 9 ] , iterative filtering [ 23 ] , straight-line displacement trajectories [ 24 ] , structural priors [ 25 ] , or deterministic diffusion [ 26 ] , and Noise2Score3D [ 27 ] learns without clean targets.
Completion methods recover missing structure through geometry-aware transformers [ 10 ] or by jointly predicting completed points and assembly-ready primitives [ 11 ] .
These methods operate on coordinates alone.
Image guidance has been added to both tasks: joint bilateral upsampling [ 28 ] and stereo pipelines [ 29 ] use color and confidence to refine depth or points, P2P-Bridge [ 30 ] conditions each point on RGB and DINOv2 [ 31 ] features, and ViPC [ 12 ] , GAPM [ 13 ] , EGIInet [ 32 ] , and IAET [ 33 ] combine a partial cloud with a single reference image.
In these methods, image features are attached to points or drawn from one view, without the per-view depth and viewing rays of calibrated multi-view capture.
Our correction keeps the evidence tied to each viewing ray, and our completion conditions a shape prior on calibrated multi-view evidence at global, ray, and local scales.
blocks.zh:
学习的登革热者利用学习得分[9],迭代过滤[23],直线迁移轨迹[24],结构前传[25],或确定传播[26],Noise2Score3D[27],在没有干净目标的情况下学习。
完成方法通过几何感知变压器[10]或联合预测完成的点和组装准备的原始物来回收缺失的结构[11].
这些方法仅在坐标上运作。
两个任务都增加了图像指导:联合双边提升标本[28]和立体管[29]使用颜色和信心来精炼深度或点,P2P-Bridge[30]在RGB和DINov2[31]特性上每个点的条件,以及ViPC[12],GAPM[13],EGIInet[32],IAET[33]结合了部分云与单一参考图像.
在这些方法中,图像特征被附着在点上或从一个视图中抽取,没有校准的多视图捕捉的每视图深度和视线.
我们的校正使证据与每个视线相连,我们的完成条件在经过校准的全局,射线,以及局部尺度的多视图证据之前是形状.

blocks.en:
Point-based CAD reconstruction predicts B-rep primitives and their incidence [ 34 ] , fits analytic and neural surfaces and recovers edges and topology by intersection [ 3 ] , or translates points into executable CAD code [ 35 ] .
Image-based methods generate parametric CAD models from images [ 36 , 37 ] , and BrepGaussian [ 38 ] recovers B-reps from multi-view images through Gaussian splatting and labeled point sampling.
In fitting-based pipelines, sample placement determines the surface parameters, whereas coverage constrains surface extents and intersections, so their results depend on input quality that underwater stereo does not guarantee.
Rather than proposing a new CAD backend, we improve the input geometry and measure its downstream utility with a shared fitting backend.

Ray evidence indicates where a surface is supported but does not fix the exact position of each generated point on it.
The decoded points are therefore projected back into the V V views to gather local image, depth, and ray evidence, and an attention-based refiner updates their coordinates while down-weighting views that confidently place a point behind an observed surface.
A final patch-height head displaces generated points along normals estimated from nearby observed support, falling back to normals of the generated patch when this support is insufficient.
The model is initialized from the UniCo backbone, trained on the corrected and filtered inputs with the external point and image encoders frozen, and minimizes the symmetric squared Chamfer distance between the union of retained and generated points and samples of the training CAD surfaces (Appendix A-C ).
The N g N_{g} generated points are mapped back by 𝒩 − 1 ​ ( 𝐪 ) = s ​ 𝐑 𝖳 ​ 𝐪 + 𝐜 \mathcal{N}^{-1}(\mathbf{q})=s\mathbf{R}^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{q}+\mathbf{c} and appended to P r P_{r} , preserving the metric frame without post-hoc alignment.

blocks.en:
We partition the recovered point cloud into face-instance groups with ParSeNet [ 14 ] and manually revise the groups so that each represents a single surface patch. This is the only human-assisted step of the pipeline (Appendix B-C ).
A Point2CAD-derived backend [ 3 ] fits each group with the best-scoring analytic surface among planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, and tori, and estimates its finite extent from the recovered points and the multi-view observation support.
The resulting solid primitives are combined by Boolean union and cavity subtraction in Open CASCADE [ 44 ] , ranked by point support, and refined by observation-supported member repair (Appendix D-D ).
An accepted output is a closed, positive-volume B-rep solid that survives STEP and native B-rep round trips and has explicit surface geometry and face–edge topology that standard CAD software can edit.

一个 Point2CAD 衍生的后端 [3] 适合每组在飞机,气瓶,锥体,球体和托里之间得到最佳评分的分析表面,并从回收点和多视图观测支持中估计其有限范围.
由此产生的固体原始物由布尔结合和腔减法在Open CASCADE [44] 中合并而成,按点支持排序,并通过观测支持的成员修补(Appendix D-D )加以完善.
一个被接受的输出是一个闭合的,正体积的B-rep固件,在STEP和原生的B-rep环形旅行中幸存下来,并且具有明显的表面几何和面端地形,标准CAD软件可以编辑.

blocks.en:
Our synthetic dataset, built with OceanSim [ 45 ] , contains 185 CAD objects in three groups of increasing geometric and structural complexity: 75 simple pipes and joints (Layer1), 75 complex assemblies such as pipe networks and support frames (Layer2), and 35 industrial parts from the ABC dataset [ 46 ] (Layer3).
Each object is rendered against five largely featureless seabed backgrounds, such as sand and gravel, along two randomized trajectories per background, under moderate scattering combined with randomly sampled moderate or severe motion blur.
Each sequence contains 100 calibrated stereo pairs at 960 × 540 960\times 540 resolution, and the source CAD models provide metric reference surfaces for supervision and evaluation.
We split the objects into 148 training, 18 validation, and 19 test objects with 1,472, 180, and 190 sequences, respectively. The test split follows the group proportions with 8, 8, and 3 objects from Layer1, Layer2, and Layer3.
All learned components are trained in stages on this split.

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluation Metrics

blocks.en:
We report the bidirectional Chamfer distance (CD, in mm) between output points and the reference CAD surface, together with the F-scores F 5 F_{5} and F 20 F_{20} at 5 and 20 mm.
For missing-region recovery, reference samples farther than 20 mm from the completion input form the missing set, and R τ R_{\tau} is the fraction of this set lying within τ \tau mm of the output. We report R 5 R_{5} and R 20 R_{20} .
Exact definitions and the aggregation over objects are given in Appendix B-A .

An output is closed if it is a positive-volume solid that survives STEP and native B-rep round trips.
A closed output passes exterior acceptance if its mean surface distance to the reference (CAD CD), its two-sided surface coverage, its largest dimension error, and its volume error all fall within fixed tolerances relative to the reference size (Appendix B-B ).

blocks.en: IV-C Reconstruction Results and Comparisons
blocks.zh: 重建成果和比较

blocks.en:
On the 190 test sequences of 19 objects, Aqua2CAD improves both the accuracy and the coverage of the recovered geometry (Table IV , first and fourth rows).
Relative to the foreground-input reconstruction, it reduces CD from 16.29 to 6.48 mm (about 60%) and raises F 5 F_{5} from 41.75% to 61.40% and F 20 F_{20} from 82.86% to 94.31%.
On the 170 sequences of 17 objects with nonempty missing regions, it achieves R 5 = 24.16 % R_{5}=24.16\% and R 20 = 83.54 % R_{20}=83.54\% (qualitative results and failure modes in Appendices E and D-E ).

blocks.en:
Before quality filtering, our local regressor raises F 5 F_{5} from 43.62% to 51.21% relative to PGD, the strongest coordinate-only baseline on all three metrics (Table I ).
Quality filtering further reduces CD from 14.82 to 10.95 mm on the same subset.
Visually assisted P2P-Bridge attains the lowest CD among the external denoisers, whereas our regressor achieves a higher F 5 F_{5} . With quality filtering, our method obtains the best CD and F-scores in this comparison.
Appendix C-B details baseline training, checkpoint selection, and test coverage.

All methods are trained on the 1,472 in-domain sequences: EGIInet [ 32 ] and IAET [ 33 ] each receive one underwater image, point-only UniCo [ 11 ] receives coordinates only, and our model uses eight views.
Point-only UniCo and our model use the same training data and training budget, so their comparison reflects the added multi-view conditioning.
Relative to point-only UniCo, our model improves F 5 F_{5} by 1.24 and R 5 R_{5} by 7.89 percentage points, whereas UniCo retains a slightly lower CD and higher F 20 F_{20} and R 20 R_{20} . Our gain therefore concentrates on recovery at the tighter 5 mm tolerance.
Our R 5 R_{5} is higher on 14 of the 17 objects with missing regions, and Fig. 5 shows an example in which both methods cover a similar extent of the missing surface at 20 mm, but our points lie much closer to it (see Fig. 7 for a second example).

We draw one sequence per test object at random from its ten trajectories and keep this mapping fixed for the foreground-input, filtered, and completed point clouds, all of which use manually revised face groups (Sec. III-C ), the same backend, and observation-supported member repair (Appendix D-D ).
Exterior acceptance rises from 6/19 to 12/19 after correction and filtering and to 14/19 after completion, while all three inputs yield 19 closed outputs and the median CAD CD decreases from 9.70 to 2.71 and then to 2.67 mm (Table III ).
Correction and filtering thus account for most of the gain in CAD accuracy, while completion adds two exterior passes.
Among the five remaining failures, the two ROV cages lack more than two thirds of their reference surface in the completion input, and completion recovers little of such large missing regions (Appendix D-E ).
Figure 10 shows all 19 cases, and Appendix B-B details the scoring protocol. A direct image-to-CAD baseline is reported in Appendix C-E .

blocks.en: IV-D Real-World Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-D 现实世界评价

blocks.en:
We apply the regressor, quality filter, completion model, and CAD backend trained or configured on synthetic data to the real captures without fine-tuning.
Foreground masks are obtained with human assistance: an annotator corrects the masks on key frames, and SAM 2 [ 48 ] propagates them through each sequence.
Face groups for CAD fitting are revised manually (Appendix B-C ), and the design models are not used at any stage.

我们应用递归器,质量滤波器,完成模型,以及CAD后端在合成数据上经过训练或配置到真实的捕获中,而不进行微调.
前景面罩是在人的帮助下获得的:一个注释者纠正钥匙框上的面罩,SAM 2[48]通过每个序列传播.
CAD装配的面团是手动修改的(Appendix B-C),任何阶段都不使用设计模型.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 shows the reconstructed point clouds and CAD models for four objects, and Fig. 8 in the appendix shows all six.
Completion appends 8,192 points to each sequence. Most coincide with observed surfaces, while the rest fill the underside, which the camera never observes because the objects rest on the pool floor or on supports.
From the completed point clouds, the reconstructed CAD models recover the main structure of each object, including the bend of the elbow, the branches of the pipe network and the joints, and the frame and header pipe of the PLET.
Errors remain, such as a step in the elbow, a crease at the Y-joint junction, and a closed hollow cylinder (Fig. 8 ).

blocks.en: IV-E Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-E 分析与分析

blocks.en:
Table IV isolates the successive contributions of local regression, quality filtering, and completion on all 190 test sequences.
Regression improves the placement of existing samples and raises F 5 F_{5} from 41.75% to 52.01%. Quality filtering further reduces CD from 14.98 to 10.53 mm, and completion extends the retained geometry, raising F 5 F_{5} to 61.40% and F 20 F_{20} to 94.31%.
The pipeline thus improves the reliability of the observed support before extending its coverage.
When foreground-input, corrected, and filtered points are passed through the same frozen completion checkpoint, upstream correction and filtering raise the final F 5 F_{5} from 50.65% to 61.40% (Appendix D-C ), confirming that completion benefits from a more reliable input.
Among the regressor ablations, restricting the regressor to a single valid view per point causes the largest drop in F 5 F_{5} , 8.94 percentage points (Appendix D-A ).
blocks.zh:
表四隔离了所有190个测试序列的局部回归、质量过滤和完成的连续贡献。
退航改进了现有样品的放置,并将F 5 F_{5}从41.75%提高到52.01%. 质量过滤进一步将CD从14.98毫米减少到10.53毫米,完成后将保留的几何学扩展,将F 5 F_{5}提高到61.40%,F 20 F_{20}提高到94.31%.
因此,管道在扩大覆盖范围之前,提高了所观测到的支助的可靠性。
当前置输入,校正,过滤的点通过同一冻结的完成检查点时,上游校正和过滤将最终的F 5 F_{5}从50.65%提升至61.40%(附录D-C),确认完成来自更可靠的输入.
在退缩指数中,将退缩指数限制在每点一个有效的视图内,造成F 5 F = 5 } 的最大下降,为8.94个百分点(附录D-A )。

blocks.en:
To isolate the parts of the completion model, we remove one component at a time and fine-tune each variant from the same initialization as the full model, with identical data, loss, optimizer, and validation-based selection (Table IV , Appendix D-B ).
Removing local refinement causes the largest drop and halves R 5 R_{5} from 24.16% to 12.35%, so generated points need view-guided adjustment to lie on the surface.
With a single view, R 5 R_{5} falls to 16.71%, close to the 16.27% of point-only UniCo (Table II ), which attributes the gain in missing-region recovery to multi-view evidence.
Removing ray evidence lowers R 5 R_{5} by 2.5 and F 5 F_{5} by 1.8 percentage points, whereas removing global image context changes every metric by about one point or less and slightly raises R 20 R_{20} , so it contributes least of the four components.
blocks.zh:
为了隔离完成模型的各个部分,我们一次移除一个组件,并对每个变体进行微调,使其从与完整模型相同的初始化,具有相同的数据,丢失,优化和基于验证的选择(表四,附录D-B.).

以单一观点来看,R 5 R_{5}跌至16.71%,接近16.27%的点唯一UniCo(表二),这把缺失区域恢复的收益归结为多视图证据.
移除射线证据将R 5 R_{5}降低2.5和F 5 F_{5}降低1.8个百分点,而移除全局图像上下文则会改变每个公尺大约1点或更小,并略微提升R 20 R_{20},因此在四个组件中贡献最小.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Aqua2CAD, which uses multi-view observations both to correct reconstructed underwater points and to condition the inference of missing geometry.
On synthetic data, it improves point accuracy and coverage, and with a common human-assisted CAD backend, exterior acceptance rises from 6/19 for the foreground-input reconstruction to 14/19. On pool captures of six 3D-printed objects, the recovered CAD models reproduce their main structure.
Face grouping remains human-assisted, and surface selection and finite-solid assembly remain bottlenecks. Automating these steps is a natural next step toward fully automatic underwater image-to-CAD reconstruction .

我们提出了Aqua2CAD,它利用多视图观测来纠正重建的水下点,并设定缺失几何的推论条件.

blocks.en: A-A Reconstruction and Training

blocks.en:
Of the 185 × 5 × 2 = 1,850 185\times 5\times 2=1{,}850 planned synthetic sequences, six training sequences failed rendering or acquisition checks and two failed SfM registration.
Camera motion is estimated from all 100 stereo pairs of a sequence with COLMAP [ 39 ] .

blocks.en:
The local regressor is trained from scratch with AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
Each batch contains four sequences with 256 randomly sampled points per sequence, and object-balanced weighting compensates for unequal sequence counts.
After the regressor is frozen, the HGB classifier is trained on statistics of the original observations, with labels defined by the proximity of the corrected points to the training surfaces, and a retention threshold of 0.7.
The multi-view assisted completion model is initialized from UniCo trained on the full training split and then trained on the corrected and filtered point clouds.
The three components are trained in this order, so that each downstream component learns from the outputs of the trained upstream stages.

每批包含四个序列,每个序列有256个随机抽取的点,对象平衡加权补偿不平等序列计数.

多视图辅助完成模型从UniCo开始初始化,培训内容为完全训练分离,然后培训内容为校正和过滤的点云。

blocks.en:

The tool runs no fitting and exposes no reference geometry, reference face labels, surface types, or parameters.
The annotator merges groups that belong to the same surface and splits groups that span several surfaces by selecting points with polygon or brush tools. Selection can be restricted to the visible surface, and completed points can be hidden during selection but are never removed.
Surface types and coaxial relations can optionally be specified. When they are left empty, the fitter estimates the surface types as in the automatic setting.
Every edit is saved with undo and a revision history, and a sequence enters reconstruction only after it is marked complete and submitted as an immutable snapshot that preserves the coordinates, order, and identities of all points.
For the 17 real-world trajectories in Sec. IV-D , the annotator changed the ParSeNet grouping on 14 and confirmed it unchanged on three, yielding 109 face groups. No optional surface types or relations were entered.

blocks.en: C-A Comparison Setup

blocks.en:
All point-cloud stages are evaluated on the same 190 test sequences and reference surfaces.
For the denoising comparison, StraightPCF [ 24 ] , IterativePFN [ 23 ] , P2P-Bridge [ 30 ] , PGD [ 25 ] , DPCD [ 26 ] , and Noise2Score3D [ 27 ] are initialized from their released weights and fine-tuned on all 1,472 in-domain training sequences, whereas our local regressor is trained from scratch on the same sequences.
Noise2Score3D retains its unsupervised training objective.
We evaluate both coordinate-only P2P-Bridge and a visually assisted variant that conditions each point on RGB and DINOv2 [ 31 ] features from eight underwater views.
Coordinate-only baselines receive point coordinates, whereas our regressor additionally uses the associated multi-view evidence. The comparison therefore controls the in-domain training data while each method retains its own inputs and initialization.
Coordinate-only P2P-Bridge requires at least 512 input points and therefore excludes ten sequences of one test object, whereas the visual variant supports all 190 sequences.
DPCD has one additional patch-stitching failure, so the matched denoising comparison uses 179 test sequences of 18 objects.
For SuperPC [ 47 ] , we reconstruct the unreleased training components from the paper and the released code while retaining the released visual architecture and pretrained initialization. We refer to this version as SuperPC (adapted) and describe it in Sec. C-D .
The same SuperPC checkpoint, fine-tuned on the 1,472 filtered-input training sequences and selected on completion validation, is evaluated in both settings under the protocols of Tables I and II : its native 2,048-point prediction from foreground inputs, and its native output appended to the full filtered input. Section C-D reports both results.
Sections C-B and C-C report test coverage and baseline training details.

对于SuperPC [47],我们从纸张和发布代码中重建未释放的训练组件,同时保留已释放的视觉架构和预先训练的初始化. 我们把这个版本称为SuperPC(适应),并在Sec. C-D.中描述.
同一个SuperPC检查点,在1,472个过滤输入培训序列上进行了微调,并在完成验证时选定,在表一和表二的协议下,在两种情况下都进行了评价:其原生2,048点来自前置输入的预测,其原生输出附在全过滤输入后. C-D节报告这两种结果。
C-B节和C-C节报告测试范围和基线培训细节。

blocks.en: C-B Denoising Baselines
blocks.zh: C-B 界定基线

blocks.en:
StraightPCF, IterativePFN, and coordinate-only P2P-Bridge are fine-tuned on the full 1,472-sequence training split, starting from the released weights with a fresh optimizer.
Target points are the nearest projections of the training observations onto their training CAD surfaces.
Training patches contain actual stereo reconstruction errors, and no synthetic Gaussian noise is added.
When an input contains fewer points than the training patch size, observed indices are repeated together with their paired targets.
Each adaptation retains the complete released network and its losses: StraightPCF uses two velocity modules with two internal iterations, IterativePFN retains its four modules, and P2P-Bridge uses its full coordinate-based model with five inference steps.
Each epoch samples eight patches per sequence with a batch size of eight.
We train for at most 100 epochs, validate every five epochs, and stop after ten validation checks without improvement.
The learning rates are 10 − 5 10^{-5} for StraightPCF and IterativePFN and 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} for P2P-Bridge.
The former two use Adam, whereas P2P-Bridge uses AdamW with a weight decay of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , gradient clipping at 1, and mixed precision. Batches with non-finite mixed-precision outputs are replayed in full precision.
blocks.zh:
直立PCF,IterativePFN,以及仅坐标的P2P-Bridge在完整的1,472序列的训练分裂上进行微调,从释放的重量开始使用新鲜的优化器.
目标点是培训观测结果最接近于培训的CAD表面的预测。
训练补丁包含实际的立体重建错误,不添加合成高斯噪音.
当输入的点数少于训练补丁大小时,观察到的指数会与其配对的目标一起重复.
每项适应保留了完整的释放网络及其损失: 直立PCF使用两个具有两个内部迭代的速率模块,IterativePFN保留其四个模块,P2P-Bridge使用其全坐标模型,并有五个推论步骤.
每个纪元样本每个序列8个补丁,批量大小为8个.
我们最多训练100个世纪,每5个世纪验证一次,10次验证检查后停止,没有改进.
P2P-Bridge的学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5。
前者使用亚当,而P2P-Bridge则使用亚当W,重量衰变为10−5 10−5},梯度剪切为1,精度混合. 具有非无限混合精度输出的蝙蝠机完全精确地重播.

blocks.en:
Checkpoint selection maximizes the object-averaged validation F 5 F_{5} under a fixed reference-sample distance proxy, subject to input-relative constraints: CD at most 1.02 times, recall at most 0.01 below, and the 95th-percentile point-to-reference distance at most 1.05 times the corresponding input values.
If no checkpoint satisfies these constraints, the checkpoint with the highest validation F 5 F_{5} is selected.
This proxy is used only for selection, and test metrics follow the exact definitions in Sec. B-A .
StraightPCF reaches the 100-epoch limit and selects epoch 60.
IterativePFN and P2P-Bridge stop at epoch 50, and the fallback rule selects the released weights for both.
blocks.zh:
检查点选择在固定的参考样本距离代理下,在输入相对限制下,将对象平均验证最大化 F 5 F_{5}: CD最多为1.02次,在下面最多0.01次回忆,95百分点对参照距离最多为对应输入值的1.05倍.
如果没有检查站满足这些限制,则选定经最高审定的F 5 F _{5}检查站。
此代理仅用于选择,测试度量法遵循 Sec. B-A 中的确切定义.
直立PCF达到100世纪极限并选择60世纪.
迭代PFN和P2P-Bridge在50号时停止,倒置规则为两者选择释放重量.

blocks.en:
Pairing observations with surface targets requires three method-specific adaptations.
For StraightPCF, a zero-residual loss ratio is replaced by its continuous limit, leaving all nonzero divisions unchanged.
IterativePFN uses n n paired projected targets instead of its original oversampled clean target set while retaining its internal noisy intermediate targets, whose noise scale is computed from the observation-to-projection residual.
P2P-Bridge uses mean and maximum-radius normalization of the observed patch with index-paired projected targets, and retains its released online-weight inference setting.
At test time, StraightPCF and IterativePFN use patches of min ⁡ ( 1000 , n ) \min(1000,n) points without padding, where n n is the number of input points.
P2P-Bridge uses min ⁡ ( 2048 , n ) \min(2048,n) points and marks inputs with n < 512 n<512 as unsupported. The ten such test sequences belong to one industrial part and remain in the 190-sequence coverage denominator.
The same rule yields 170 supported validation sequences for P2P-Bridge, whereas the other two methods use all 180.
Over all 190 test sequences, StraightPCF obtains 16.49 mm CD, 44.59% F 5 F_{5} , and 82.33% F 20 F_{20} , and IterativePFN obtains 17.48 mm, 42.91%, and 80.92%.
blocks.zh:
与表面目标对齐的观测需要三种特定方法的修改.
对于直立PCF来说,零残损比被其连续的极限所取代,使得所有非零分割不变.
迭代式PFN使用n配对的预计目标,而不是其最初的过标的清洁目标,同时保留其内部吵闹的中间目标,其噪声尺度由观察到预测的剩余量计算.
P2P-Bridge使用被观测到的补丁与指数化预测目标的中间和最大辐射正常化,并保留其发布的在线加权推论设置.
在测试时,直立PCF和IterativePFN使用min QQ(1000,n)\min(1000,n)点的补丁而不粘贴,其中n是输入点数.
P2P-Bridge使用min QQ(2048,n)\min(2048,n)点,并标记输入值为n < 512 n<512)为不支持值. 10个这样的测试序列属于一个工业部分,仍保留在190序列覆盖分母中.
同样的规则为P2P-Bridge得出170个支持的验证序列,而其他两种方法则全部使用180个.
在所有190个试验序列中,直立PCF获得16.49毫米CD,44.59%F 5 F_{5}和82.33%F 20 F_{20},IterativePFN获得17.48毫米,42.91%和80.92%.

blocks.en:
The visual variant starts from the official P2P-Bridge checkpoint trained on ScanNet++ [ 49 ] with RGB and DINOv2 features, using a fresh optimizer and an EMA reinitialized from the same online weights.
Eight fixed underwater left views provide three RGB channels and 384 DINOv2 ViT-S/14 channels per foreground point, giving 387 conditioning channels.
Features are gathered with the estimated cameras and observed-point visibility while preserving correspondence to the original foreground points.
Adaptation performs 100,000 updates with a batch size of four and 4,096-point patches, and all 180 validation sequences are evaluated at step zero and every 10,000 updates without early stopping.
The selection rule above chooses step 100,000, and inference uses EMA weights with ten steps.
Short inputs repeat observed indices together with their features, and stitching restores the original point identities, so all 190 test sequences yield valid outputs.
Over all 190 sequences, this variant obtains 11.65 mm CD, 46.95% F 5 F_{5} , and 83.87% F 20 F_{20} .
Because the two variants use different fine-tuning and short-input protocols, their comparison reflects the complete variants.
blocks.zh:
视觉变体起源于ScanNet++[49]上训练的官方P2P-Bridge检查点,具有RGB和DINOv2的功能,使用新鲜的优化器和从相同的在线权重重新初始化的EMA.
8个固定的水下左视图提供了3个RGB频道和384个DINov2 VIT-S/14频道,每个前方点给出387个调节频道.
地物与估计的相机和观测点的能见度一起收集,同时保留与原前缘点的通信.
适应进行10万个更新,批量大小为4个和4,096个点补丁,所有180个验证序列在0级进行评价,每1万个更新没有提前停止.
以上选择规则选择步骤10万,推论使用EMA权重10步.
短输入会重复所观测到的指数及其特征,缝合会恢复原点身份,所以所有190个测试序列都产生有效的输出.
在所有190个序列中,该变体获得11.65毫米CD,46.95%F 5 F_{5}和83.87%F 20 F_{20}.
由于两个变体使用不同的微调和短输入协议,它们的比较反映了完整的变体.

blocks.en: C-C Completion Baselines
blocks.zh: C-C 完成基线

blocks.en:
Table II uses the same filtered inputs for EGIInet, IAET, point-only UniCo, and our multi-view assisted completion model.
Point-only UniCo receives filtered coordinates without image features, retains every input point, and appends 8,192 generated points. It is trained on the same 1,472 sequences with the same training budget as our model, which follows the same retention rule and generated-point count.
blocks.zh:
表二使用相同的过滤输入EGIInet,IAET,只点UniCo,以及我们的多视图辅助完成模式.
只点 Unico接收没有图像特性的过滤坐标,保留每个输入点,并附加8,192个生成点. 其培训内容与我们的模式相同,培训预算为1 472个序列,遵循相同的保留规则和生成点数。

blocks.en:
EGIInet [ 32 ] starts from the released eight-category checkpoint and is fine-tuned for 160 epochs, and the 180-sequence validation set selects epoch 147.
It receives the filtered point cloud and one underwater left image (frame 32 of each sequence), resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 without a ground-truth crop or mask.
The estimated camera orientation and the centroid and maximum radius of the observed cloud define the coordinate transform and scale for both observations and targets.
EGIInet natively outputs 1,024 predicted points and 1,024 retained input samples. The common wrapper retains the entire filtered input and appends all 2,048 native points, including duplicates of retained samples.
blocks.zh:
EGIInet [32] 从发布的八类检查站开始,并对160个纪元进行了微调,180序列验证集选择了纪元147.
它接收过滤的点云和一个水下左图像(每个序列的框32),大小调整为224×224/224\times 224,没有地面真实的作物或面具.
估计的相机方向以及观测云的中间体和最大半径确定了观测和目标的坐标变换和尺度.
EGIInet原生输出1,024预测点和1,024保留输入样本. 常见的包装机保留了整个过滤的输入,并附加了所有2,048个本土点,包括保留样品的重复.

blocks.en:
IAET [ 33 ] starts from the official pretrained checkpoint and uses the same image, coordinate normalization, and 2,048 sampled input points as EGIInet.
We retain its four-stage architecture and losses and fine-tune for 200 epochs (4,600 updates) without early stopping, using Adam with a batch size of 64 and an initial learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} that decays by a factor of 0.7 every 20 epochs.
The initial checkpoint and every epoch are evaluated on all 180 validation sequences, and the lowest object-averaged physical CD of the native output selects epoch 83.
Training and validation take 14.95 minutes on two RTX 5090 GPUs.
The native IAET output alone reaches a CD of 11.88 mm, F 5 = 21.31 % F_{5}=21.31\% , and F 20 = 83.25 % F_{20}=83.25\% , and its recovery rates remain 8.66% and 72.98%.
blocks.zh:
IAET [33]从官方预先训练的检查站开始,使用相同的图像,协调正常化,2,048个抽查输入点与EGIInet相同.
我们保留了它的四级建筑和损失,并微调了200个纪元(4,600个更新),没有提前停止,使用亚当的批量尺寸为64个,初始学习率为10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 },每20个纪元衰减系数为0.7。
对所有180个验证序列的初始检查点和每个纪元都进行了评价,本地输出中最小对象平均物理CD选择纪元83.
两台RTX 5090 GPU的训练和验证需要14.95分钟.
仅IAET本地产出就达到11.88毫米的CD,F 5 = 21.31 % F_{5}=21.31\%,F 20 = 83.25% F_{20}=83.25\%,其回收率保持8.66%和72.98%.

blocks.en:
EGIInet, IAET, and SuperPC (adapted, Sec. C-D ) each append their 2,048 native output points to the full filtered input.
All methods complete all 190 test sequences, and the filtered input defines a nonempty missing region on 170 sequences of 17 objects.
blocks.zh:
EGIInet,IAET,和SuperPC(改编,Sec.C-D)各附加其2,048个本土输出点到全过滤输入.
所有的方法都完成了所有190个测试序列,经过过滤的输入定义了170个序列17个物体上的非空缺失区域.

blocks.en:
Figure 7 compares point-only UniCo and our model on two test sequences with identical filtered inputs.
In both examples, the two outputs reach a similar R 20 R_{20} , whereas our R 5 R_{5} is about three times higher: 38.1% versus 11.4% on the pipe network and 32.4% versus 10.6% on the reducer.
Over the 170 test sequences with nonempty missing regions, our R 5 R_{5} is higher on 137 sequences and on 14 of the 17 objects.
The examples were chosen to illustrate this difference and are not representative of its magnitude.
blocks.zh:
图7比较了两个测试序列上仅有点的UniCo和我们的模型,相同的过滤输入.
在这两个例子中,两种产出都达到了相似的R 20 R_{20},而我们的R 5 R_{5}大约是三倍:管道网络的38.1%对11.4%,管道管道的32.4%对10.6%。
超过170个试验序列,无空缺失区域,我们的R 5 R_{5}在137个序列和17个天体中的14个序列上都更高.
选择这些例子是为了说明这种差异,并不代表其规模。

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Missing-region recovery of point-only UniCo and our model from identical filtered inputs. Gray: reference surface samples within 20 mm of the filtered input. Dark gray: the missing region, i.e., reference samples farther than 20 mm from it. In the last two columns, each sample of the missing region is colored by its distance to the method output. Each row uses the viewpoint that shows the most samples of the missing region.
blocks.zh: 图7: 缺失区域从相同的过滤输入中恢复仅点的UniCo和我们的模型. 灰色:滤光输入20毫米范围内的参考表面样本. 暗灰色(Dark gray):缺失的区域,即比它远20毫米的参考样本. 在最后两列中,缺失区域的每个样本按其与方法输出的距离来配色. 每行使用显示缺失区域样本最多的视角.

blocks.en: C-D SuperPC Adaptation
blocks.zh: C-D 超级PC 适应

blocks.en:
We reconstruct the unreleased SuperPC [ 47 ] training components from its paper and public release while preserving the released visual network and pretrained initialization.
The reconstructed objective regresses the conditional flow velocity along a linear source–target path, with interpolation time ξ = 1 − cos ⁡ ( π ​ U / 2 ) \xi=1-\cos(\pi U/2) for U ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) U\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1) and source jitter with a standard deviation of 0.01.
Training uses fixed exact Hungarian correspondences computed before jittering instead of online auction matching on noisy sources.
We correct the image projection to the standard pinhole form u = f x ​ x / z + c x u=f_{x}x/z+c_{x} and v = f y ​ y / z + c y v=f_{y}y/z+c_{y} after restoring the estimated camera coordinates and scaling the intrinsics to the resized image, and keep the visual encoder frozen.
The model is fine-tuned on all 1,472 training sequences with 2,048 sampled filtered points and the full underwater left image of frame 32, resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 without a ground-truth crop or mask.
The centroid and radius of the observed points and the estimated cameras define the point transform.
Adam uses a global batch size of 64 on two RTX 5090 GPUs and an initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , halved every 20 epochs.
All 180 validation sequences are evaluated every five epochs, with early stopping after ten checks without improvement and a limit of 500 epochs.
Training stops at epoch 110 after 43.08 minutes, and the lowest object-averaged physical CD selects epoch 60.
Inference uses 25 Euler steps without output clipping and produces 2,048 native points.
For completion, the output retains the entire filtered input and appends these points, following the protocol of Table II .
For denoising, the same checkpoint receives the foreground input, sampled to 2,048 points with deterministic repetition for shorter clouds, and returns its native 2,048-point prediction, following the protocol of Table I . The centroid and radius are recomputed from this input with the same image and camera rules.
Neither evaluation involves additional denoising training or checkpoint selection.
On the 179 shared denoising test sequences, the native prediction obtains a CD of 39.65 mm, F 5 = 9.99 % F_{5}=9.99\% , and F 20 = 58.97 % F_{20}=58.97\% , worse than its foreground input (16.20 mm, 40.29%, and 82.32% in Table I ).
Appended to the filtered input, it gives a CD of 9.07 mm, F 5 = 53.45 % F_{5}=53.45\% , F 20 = 87.38 % F_{20}=87.38\% , R 5 = 0.78 % R_{5}=0.78\% , and R 20 = 30.21 % R_{20}=30.21\% (Table II ).

blocks.en: C-E Direct Image-to-CAD Baseline
blocks.zh: C-E 直接图像对CAD 基线

blocks.en:
We evaluate the released CADrille-RL [ 37 ] weights, without in-domain fine-tuning, on 19 test sequences, one per test object.
Each input consists of four underwater left images spanning the trajectory (frames 0, 32, 66, and 98).
A frozen SegFormer-B2 predicts the foreground on these images.
Each crop is centered on the predicted foreground box, all four views share one square crop size, and pixels outside the predicted foreground are set to white.
The four crops form the official 268 × 268 268\times 268 input grid.
Each input receives one greedy prediction capped at 768 new tokens, and the generated program is executed directly to export the resulting solid to STEP.
blocks.zh:
我们评估释放的CADrille-RL[37]重量,不进行域内微调,在19个测试序列上,每个测试对象一个.
每次输入都包含4幅横跨轨道的水下左图(框架0、32、66和98)。
冰冻的SegFormer-B2预言了这些图像的前缘.
每个作物都以预测前景框为中心,所有四个视图都共享一个平方作物大小,预测前景外的像素设定为白色.
这四种作物组成了正式的268×268268\time268输入网.
每个输入都收到一个贪婪的预测,封顶为768新令牌,生成的程序直接执行,将产生的固体导出到STEP.

blocks.en:
All 19 STEP outputs are readable, and 18 pass the readback validity and closure checks, which permit multiple solids and require valid positive-volume solids, closed oriented shells, and consistent boundary incidence.
Seventeen outputs contain two to six solids, and the output for one ROV cage has near-zero volume and fails the positive-volume check.
None of the 19 outputs passes the exterior acceptance criteria of Sec. IV-B .
blocks.zh:
所有19个STEP输出都是可读的,18个通过回溯有效性和关闭检查,允许多个固件,并需要有效的正体积固件,面向封闭的壳体,以及一致的边界事件.
17个输出包含2至6个固件,一个ROV笼的输出体积接近零,并未能进行正积检查.
在19项产出中,没有任何一项通过四-B节的外部接受标准。

blocks.en:
For shape evaluation, each prediction and reference mesh is independently centered and normalized by its longest bounding-box side.
They are aligned by searching 24 proper axis rotations followed by rigid ICP [ 50 ] at the normalized scale.
CD is the mean bidirectional distance from 10,000 area-weighted surface samples to the opposite triangle surface and is expressed as a percentage of the normalized longest side (Table V ). The F 2 % F_{2\%} score uses 10,000 surface samples per mesh and a threshold of 0.02.
blocks.zh:
对于形状评价,每个预测和参考网格都由最长的边框进行独立中心化和正常化.
它们通过搜索24个适当的轴旋转,然后按照规范的尺度进行僵化的比较方案[50]对齐。
CD是从10,000个面积加权表面样品到相反三角表面的平均双向距离,以常态最长一侧的百分比表示(表五)。 F2%的F_{2\%}分使用每网格1万个表面样本,阈值0.02.

blocks.en: TABLE V: Shape accuracy of CADrille-RL from underwater images. All metrics are percentages and are computed after independent scale normalization and alignment. Shape scoring covers all 19 readable STEP outputs.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他分析

blocks.en: D-A Local-Regressor Ablation Protocol
blocks.zh: D-A 局部退缩协议

blocks.en: TABLE VI: Local-regressor ablations on the 190 test sequences of 19 objects. All variants are trained on the 1,472 training sequences.
blocks.zh: 表六:在19个物体的190个测试序列上发生局部递归器淤积. 所有变体都接受了1,472个训练序列的培训.

blocks.en:
We retrain three feature variants on all 1,472 training sequences with the same 180-sequence validation set and evaluate their regression outputs on all 190 test sequences (Table VI ).
The variant without RGB removes color and RGB patch statistics.
The variant without fine signed cues removes signed depth residuals and displacement directions while retaining discrepancy magnitudes and coarse occlusion and free-space indicators.
The single-view variant retains only the first valid view per point and removes cross-view summaries and view-count features.
All variants keep the original regressor width, loss, and training schedule, and neither quality filtering nor completion is applied.
Restricting the regressor to a single view reduces F 5 F_{5} by 8.94 percentage points, far more than removing either feature family within the multi-view model, which identifies evidence across viewpoints as the dominant factor among these ablations.
These runs use a single random initialization and do not estimate cross-seed variance.
blocks.zh:
我们对所有1,472个训练序列重新进行三个特征变体的测试,并使用相同的180序列验证集,评价其所有190个测试序列的回归输出(表六)。
没有RGB的变体去除颜色和RGB补丁统计.
该变体没有经过精细签名的提示,可去除经签名的深度残留和转移方向,同时保留差异度和粗掩蔽和空闲空间指标。
单视图变体只保留每个点的第一个有效视图,并删除交叉视图摘要和视图计数特征.
所有变体都保留原有的递归器宽度,损失,以及训练时间表,并且既不采用质量过滤,也不采用完成.
将退步器限制在单一观点下,F 5 F_{5}减少了8.94个百分点,远不止于在多观点模式中消除两个特征家族,后者将跨观点的证据确定为这些杂乱无章的主导因素。
这些运行使用单个随机初始化,不估计交叉种子差异.

blocks.en: D-B Completion Ablation Protocol
blocks.zh: D-B 完成协议

blocks.en:
Each variant in Table IV starts from the same warm-start checkpoint as the full completion model and is trained on the 1,472 corrected and filtered training sequences with the same object-balanced loss, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, two-GPU batch, and seed.
Training is capped at 12 epochs, and the 180 validation sequences select the checkpoint with the same rule as for the full model, which selected epoch 9 within this cap.
The selected epochs are 9, 12, 8, and 11 for the variants in table order.
Without ray evidence, the spatial candidates, per-view ray records, ray encoder, and the residual branches that inject its context are removed.
Without global image context, the image tokens, the global cross-attention, and the image-driven anchor offset are removed.
Without local refinement, both view-guided refinement steps and the patch-height displacement are disabled.
The single-view variant keeps only the first of the eight selected views for all view-dependent inputs and draws the same number of ray candidates from that view.
Test predictions are sealed before scoring and evaluated with the same scorer as Table II , which reproduces the full-model row exactly.
Because the shared initialization was trained with all components, the variants measure the effect of removing a component during fine-tuning rather than training without it from scratch.
Each variant is trained once, so the analysis does not estimate seed variance.
blocks.zh:
表四中的每个变体都从与完全完成模式相同的暖启动检查站开始,并接受1,472个经过校正和过滤的训练序列的培训,其对象均匀损失,优化器,学习率表,双GPU批次,种子.
训练在12个纪元时封顶,180个验证序列选择了与全模式相同的检查点,全模式在这个纪元内选择了纪元9.
所选的时代为9,12,8和11,按表格顺序排列的变体.
没有射线证据,空间候选者,每视射线记录,射线编码器,以及注入其上下文的剩余分支被移除.
没有全局图像背景,图像符号,全局交叉意向,以及图像驱动主锚偏移被删除.
没有本地的精细化,既禁止以景制为导向的精细化步骤,也禁止补丁高位移位.
单视图变体只保留所有依赖视图输入的8个选定视图中的第1个,并从该视图中抽取相同数量的射线候选.
测试预测在评分前被封存,并使用与表二相同的计分器进行评估,该表完全照搬了全模排.
由于共享初始化是用所有组件进行训练的,变体在微调时衡量去除一个组件的效果,而不是从零开始去除.
每个变种都经过一次训练,因此分析不估计种子差异.

blocks.en: D-C Effect of Upstream Geometry on Completion
blocks.zh: D-C 上游几何学对完成的影响

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of upstream geometry on completion, we pass foreground-input, corrected, and filtered points through the same frozen completion checkpoint, recomputing all input features by identical rules (Table VII ).
Correction raises the final F 5 F_{5} from 50.65% to 57.94%, and quality filtering raises it further to 61.40%.
Filtering also lowers CD from 10.86 to 6.48 mm but increases R 20 R_{20} by only 0.28 percentage points, with decreases on six of the 17 eligible objects.
The completion model thus responds strongly to improved upstream geometry, with a smaller and less uniform effect on missing-region recovery.
blocks.zh:
为了隔离上游几何对完成的影响,我们通过同一冻结的完成检查点,通过前景输入,校正和过滤点,按照相同的规则重新计算所有输入特性(表七)。
校正将最终F 5 F_{5}从50.65%提高到57.94%,质量过滤进一步提高到61.40%.
过滤还使CD从10.86毫米降至6.48毫米,但只增加了0.28个百分点,17个合格对象中的6个减少。
因此,完成模型对上游几何学的改进作出了强烈反应,对缺失区域的恢复产生了较小和不太统一的影响。

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Completion with a fixed checkpoint and three upstream inputs. CD is in mm, and other metrics are percentages. CD and F-scores use 190 sequences of 19 objects, and recovery rates use 170 sequences of 17 objects with a shared nonempty missing region.
blocks.zh: 表七:用固定检查站和3个上游投入完成。 光盘为毫米,其他指标为百分比。 CD和F分数使用19个物体的190个序列,回收率使用17个物体的170个序列,共享非空缺失区域.

blocks.en:
The checkpoint is the final completion model used in the main pipeline, trained on the 1,472 sequences of 148 objects.
The corrected input applies local regression, and the filtered input additionally applies the quality classifier.
For each input, PCA normalization, sampling to 2,048 points, eight-view selection, and the geometric and ray features are recomputed with the same rules.
The output retains all input points and adds 8,192 generated points in physical coordinates without ICP alignment.
All 570 predictions succeed, and the filtered-input outputs are identical to those of the main pipeline.
All inputs share the missing-region mask defined by distances greater than 20 mm from the filtered input.
The 20 sequences of two objects with an empty mask remain in the CD and F-score evaluation and are excluded from the recovery rates.
Correction improves CD and F 5 F_{5} on all 19 objects.
Filtering further improves CD on all 19 objects and F 5 F_{5} on 18, and improves R 20 R_{20} on 11 of the 17 eligible objects. Its largest decrease in recovery is 16.79 percentage points on a subsea jacket.
This analysis measures upstream-input effects for one trained completion model, and the variants are not retrained separately.
blocks.zh:
检查站是主管道使用的最后完成型号,对148个物体的1 472个序列进行了培训。
更正后的输入应用局部回归,过滤后的输入额外应用质量分类器.
对每种输入,CPA正常化,取样到2,048点,八景选择,几何和射线特征都按照相同的规则重算.
产出保留了所有输入点,在物理坐标中增加了8 192个生成点,而没有比较方案对齐。
所有570个预测都成功,过滤的输入输出与主管道输出相同.
所有输入都共享以距离过滤输入大于20毫米的距离定义的缺失区域掩码.
带空面具的两个物体的20个序列仍保留在CD和F分数评价中,并被排除在回收率之外.
校正改进了所有19个物体的CD和F 5 F_{5}.
过滤进一步改善了所有19个对象的CD和18个对象的F 5 F_{5},改进了17个合格对象中的11个R 20 R_{20}. 其回收量最大的下降是海底夹克的16.79个百分点.
这种分析对一个训练有素的完成模型的上游投入效果进行了衡量,这些变体没有分别进行再培训。

blocks.en: D-D Observation-Supported Member Repair
blocks.zh: D-D 观察支助成员修理

blocks.en:
Member repair recovers measured components that are omitted from the assembled solid.
It identifies fitted groups that have sufficient measured support but whose point-to-surface distance increases strongly after assembly.
All nonempty replacement combinations of at most four eligible groups are considered, giving at most 15 candidates per sequence.
Candidates retain the fitted changes of the parent solid and must pass the same strict STEP and B-rep readback checks.
An observation gate requires improved coverage of the target groups, limits degradation on other supported groups and in reverse support, and requires a lower point-support cost.
The lowest-cost candidate that passes the gate is selected. Otherwise, the current solid is retained.
blocks.zh:
成员修理回收了组装固体中遗漏的测量部件。
它确定了具有足够量度支持、但其点对点距离在组装后明显增加的装配组群。
所有非空置替补组合,最多4个合格组别均得到考虑,每个序列最多15名候选人。
候选人保留母体固件的适配更改,必须通过同样的严格的STEP和B-rep回读检查.
观察门需要扩大目标群体的覆盖范围,限制其他支助群体和逆向支助的退化,并需要较低的点支助费用。
通过大门的低成本候选人被选中。 否则,保留当前固体.

blocks.en:
To fix the repair rules, we use diagnostic runs in which reference face-instance IDs supply the grouping, while surface types, parameters, boundaries, and normals are estimated from the input points.
On the 180 validation sequences, exterior acceptance increases from 93/170 to 94/170, and closure remains at 177/180. Ten sequences with invalid reference unions remain in the closure denominator.
We then apply the fixed rules unchanged to the 190 test sequences.
Of these, 159 meet the observation-sufficiency conditions and 37 trigger repair.
The search constructs 153 candidates, of which 151 pass the dual-format readback and 105 pass the observation gate, and 29 sequences adopt a changed solid.
Exterior acceptance increases from 96/190 to 98/190 without any acceptance or closure regression, and the mean CAD CD over the 189 matched closed outputs decreases from 38.27 to 36.84 mm.
On the fixed 19-sequence subset used for the image-to-CAD comparison, closure remains at 19/19 and exterior acceptance at 10/19, while the mean CAD CD decreases from 27.80 to 27.72 mm.
The comparison in Table III instead uses manually revised groups and applies member repair to all three inputs, and Fig. 10 shows the corresponding CAD outputs for all 19 sequences.
blocks.zh:
为了修正修复规则,我们使用诊断运行,其中参考面膜ID提供分组,而表面类型,参数,边界,和正常则从输入点估算.
在180个验证序列中,外部接受量从93/170增加到94/170,关闭时间仍为177/180。 关闭分母中仍保留有10个无效的参照结合序列.
然后,我们将固定规则适用于190个测试序列。
其中159个符合观察充足条件,37个触发器修复.
搜索建造了153个考生,其中151个通过双格式回读,105个通过观察门,29个序列采用改变后的固件.
外部接受量从96/190增至98/190,没有任何接受或关闭回归,平均CADCD比189个对应的封闭产出从38.27毫米降至36.84毫米。
在用于图像与CAD比较的固定的19序列子集上,关闭时间仍为19/19,外部接受时间为10/19,而平均CADCD从27.80毫米降至27.72毫米.
相反,表三中的比较使用手动修改的分组,并将成员修复应用于所有三个输入,图10显示了所有19个序列的相应CAD输出.

blocks.en: D-E Failure Modes
blocks.zh: D- E 失败模式

blocks.en:
Completion performs poorly when most of the surface is absent from its input.
We assign a test sequence to the large-gap group if more than 50% of its reference surface samples lie farther than 20 mm from its completion input.
This holds for 22 of the 190 sequences: all 20 sequences of two ROV cages, one Y-joint sequence, and one industrial part.
On these sequences, the final model recovers only 1.76% of the missing surface within 5 mm and 38.50% within 20 mm, compared with 27.18% and 89.31% on the remaining sequences, and its CD rises to 32.91 mm (Table VIII ).
With so little observed support, the multi-view evidence constrains only a small part of the shape, and the generated points cover the missing region coarsely and incompletely.
In the CAD comparison of Table III , both large-gap sequences, the two ROV cages, fail exterior acceptance for all three inputs.
blocks.zh:
当大部分表面没有输入时,完成性差。
如果50%以上的参考表面样本比完成输入的20毫米还远,我们就为大槽组分配一个试验序列。
此为190个序列中的22个:两个ROV笼的所有20个序列,一个Y-联合序列,和一个工业部分.
在这些序列上,最终型号在5毫米以内只回收1.76%的缺失表面,在20毫米以内只回收38.50%,而在其余序列上则回收27.18%和89.31%,其CD升至32.91毫米(表八).
由于观测到的支持如此之少,多视图证据只制约了形状的一小部分,生成的积分粗糙和不完整地覆盖了缺失的区域.
在表三的CAD比较中,两个大格子序列,两个ROV笼,所有三个输入都失败外在接受.

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Results of the final model grouped by the missing extent of the input. A sequence belongs to the large-gap group if more than 50% of its reference surface samples are farther than 20 mm from its completion input. Metrics are averaged per object within each group and then across objects. Recovery rates use the sequences with nonempty missing regions (22 of 4 objects with large gaps and 148 of 15 objects in the remainder).
blocks.zh: 表八:按投入缺失程度分类的最后模型的结果。 如果50%以上的参考表面样品距离其完成输入的20毫米以上,则该序列属于大槽组。 每个组内每个对象的量平均,然后跨对象。 回收率使用无空缺失区域的序列(其余4个有较大缺口的物体中有22个,15个有148个)。

blocks.en:
Five of the 19 completed inputs still fail exterior acceptance (Table III and Fig. 10 ).
Figure 9 includes the sequence with the largest gap, a Y-joint with 91.84% of its reference samples farther than 20 mm from the completion input, and the sequence with the largest CAD error, an ROV cage.
With manually revised face groups, these failures reflect the recovered geometry, surface selection, and finite-solid assembly rather than segmentation errors.
blocks.zh:
在19项已完成的投入中,有5项仍未得到外部接受(表三和图10)。
图9包括差距最大的序列、比完成输入量远达20毫米的参考样本中的91.84%的Y-联和序列、以及最大CAD误差的序列,即ROV笼。
通过人工修改面团,这些故障反映了恢复的几何,表面选择,以及有限的固态组装,而不是分割错误.

blocks.en: Appendix F Earlier Development Studies
blocks.zh: 附录F 早期发展研究

blocks.en: The studies in this section predate the current training run and use earlier data and settings. They are separate from the 190-sequence evaluation in Sec. IV-C .
blocks.zh: 本节中的研究早于目前的培训,并使用较早的数据和设置。 它们与Sec.IV-C中的190序列评价分开。

blocks.en: F-A Foreground Module
blocks.zh: F-A前景模块

blocks.en:
We evaluated a frozen SegFormer-B2 [ 41 ] with high-resolution inference and local refinement on eight synthetic CAD objects, comprising 16 sequences and 800 frames.
Depth propagation, stereo consistency, and multi-view fusion improve the object-balanced IoU (Table IX ).
The fusion parameters were selected on six separate development objects.
IoU improves on all eight evaluation objects, and thin-structure recall improves on seven.
On another background with the same evaluation objects, the mean IoU improves by 3.32 percentage points, whereas thin-structure recall for the three jacket objects decreases by 1.24 points.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了一个冷冻的SegFormer-B2[41],对8个合成CAD物体进行了高分辨率推论和局部改进,包括16个序列和800帧.
深度传播、立体一致性和多视图聚变改进了物体平衡的IoU(表九)。
聚变参数选在六个独立的开发对象上.
IoU改进了所有8个评价对象,薄结构召回改进了7个.
在另一个具有相同评价对象的背景上,平均IoU提高3.32个百分点,而三件夹克对象的薄结构召回则减少1.24个百分点.

blocks.en: TABLE IX: Development evaluation of the foreground module on eight CAD objects. All metrics are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表格 九:对8个CAD对象的前置模块进行开发评价. 所有衡量标准都是百分比。

blocks.en: F-B Local-Regressor Design
blocks.zh: F-B 本地递归器设计

blocks.en:
An earlier architecture study trained on 80 CAD objects and selected configurations on ten validation objects.
All variants in Table X preserve point identities and apply coordinate updates without quality filtering.
Doubling the observation-derived displacement bound from 1–6 mm to 2–12 mm improves F 5 F_{5} , and removing RGB statistics or fine signed depth residuals reduces it.
The latter variant retains coarse occlusion and free-space indicators and slightly improves CD, so its effect depends on the metric.
A second seed gives F 5 = 46.03 % F_{5}=46.03\% for the 2–12 mm setting.
Here, CD uses fixed surface samples in both directions, whereas Sec. B-A uses an exact point-to-mesh forward distance.
blocks.zh:
早期的建筑研究对80个CAD对象和10个验证对象的选定配置进行了培训.
表X中的所有变体都保留了点身份,并在不进行质量过滤的情况下应用坐标更新.
将从1至6毫米到2至12毫米的观测产生的迁移量翻一番,改进了F 5 F_{5},并删除了RGB统计数据或精细的署名深度残留物,减少了这种迁移。
后一种变体保留了粗杂质和空闲空间指标,并略微改进了CD,因此其效果取决于度量.
第二种子给F 5 = 46.03 % F _{5 }=46.03 \% 2–12毫米设置.
在这里,CD在双向使用固定表面样品,而Sec.B-A则使用精确的点对点前距离.

blocks.en: TABLE X: Regression design comparisons on the earlier ten-object validation set. CD is in mm and F 5 F_{5} is a percentage.
blocks.zh: 表十:前十项对象验证集的回转设计比较. CD为毫米,F 5 F_{5}是一个百分比.

blocks.en: F-C CAD Backend Diagnostics
blocks.zh: F-C CAD 后端诊断

blocks.en:
A separate 19-object study used fixed earlier point clouds and automatic ParSeNet [ 14 ] groups with a Point2CAD-derived fitting backend [ 3 ] and Open CASCADE [ 44 ] assembly.
Two variants relabel completion points with uniform or observation-derived neighborhood weights, retaining the groups of observed points and requiring strong local consensus.
Table XI compares these automatic settings with reference face groups.
This study uses input point clouds and settings different from those of Table III , but the same closure and exterior acceptance criteria (Sec. IV-B ).
Correct grouping alone does not resolve all fitting and assembly errors.
The study involves no manual editing and precedes the current point-cloud pipeline.

一项单独的19个对象研究使用了固定的较早点云和自动ParSeNet [14]组,并配有点2CAD-衍生的装配后端[3]和Open CASCADE [44]组装.
两个变体将完成点重新贴上统一或观察产生的邻里权重的标签,保留观测到的点组,要求当地达成强有力的共识.
表十一将这些自动设置与参考面团进行比较.
本研究使用与表三不同的输入点云和设置,但相同的关闭和外部接受标准(Sec.IV-B.).
仅仅正确分组并不能解决所有安装和组装错误。
这项研究不涉及人工编辑,在目前的点云管道之前进行。

blocks.en:
We also evaluated BrepGaussian [ 38 ] on six objects, two per shape group.
Each object uses 50 underwater left images, stereo-SfM camera poses, 30,000 geometry-and-edge optimization steps, and 15,000 segmentation optimization steps.
Masks receive no manual correction, and the surface fitter exports solids through Open CASCADE.
One of the six objects yields a valid closed solid, and none passes the complete acceptance checks of that study, which include observed-input coverage and volume consistency after STEP round trips.
This automatic six-object study does not provide a matched comparison with the current human-assisted pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们还对六个物体进行了BrepGausian[38]的评价,每个形状组有两个.
每个物体采用50个水下左图,立体-SfM相机姿势,3万个几何和尖端优化步骤,15,000个分区优化步骤.
遮罩没有手动校正,表面适配器通过Open CASCADE输出固体.
六个物体中有一个产生有效的封闭固体,没有一个能够通过该研究的完整验收,其中包括所观察到的输入覆盖范围和STEP往返后的体积一致性。
这种自动的六对象研究不能与目前的人力辅助管道进行比较。
